table audio_chunks
  column consultation_id TEXT not null key 1
  column sequence INTEGER not null key 2
  column first_frame INTEGER not null
  column frame_count INTEGER not null
  column dropped_before INTEGER not null
  column encrypted_audio BLOB not null
  foreign key consultation_id -> consultations(id) on delete CASCADE
  index unique (pk) consultation_id sequence
table consultation_keys
  column consultation_id TEXT key 1
  column wrapped_key BLOB not null
  foreign key consultation_id -> consultations(id) on delete CASCADE
  index unique (pk) consultation_id
table consultations
  column id TEXT key 1
  column started_at TEXT not null
  column ended_at TEXT
  column state TEXT not null
  column sample_rate INTEGER not null
  column device_id TEXT
  column device_name TEXT
  column dropped_frames INTEGER not null default 0
  column saved INTEGER not null
  column sample INTEGER not null default 0
  index unique (pk) id
  check state IN ('recording', 'finalised')
  check saved IN (0, 1)
  check sample IN (0, 1)
  check state = 'recording' OR ended_at IS NOT NULL
table documents
  column consultation_id TEXT not null key 1
  column kind TEXT not null key 2
  column revision INTEGER not null
  column language TEXT not null
  column encrypted_text BLOB not null
  column style TEXT
  column detail TEXT
  column generated_at TEXT
  column edited_at TEXT
  foreign key consultation_id -> consultations(id) on delete CASCADE
  index unique (pk) consultation_id kind
  check kind IN ('note', 'patient', 'translation', 'label', 'summary', 'reflection', 'guidance')
  check revision > 0
  check style IN ('prose', 'soap')
  check detail IN ('concise', 'detailed')
  check kind = 'note' OR (style IS NULL AND detail IS NULL)
table turns
  column consultation_id TEXT not null key 1
  column sequence INTEGER not null key 2
  column first_frame INTEGER not null
  column frame_count INTEGER not null
  column encrypted_turn BLOB not null
  foreign key consultation_id -> consultations(id) on delete CASCADE
  index unique (pk) consultation_id sequence
